## What changed?

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link related issues if applicable.

## Verification

List checks and results. Note existing failures separately.

## Screenshots

Include before/after screenshots for visible changes, including mobile when relevant.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and documentation is in English.
- [ ] Relevant build, import, and behavior checks pass.
- [ ] Documentation, public URLs, catalog totals and download instructions agree; `npm run test:docs` passes.
- [ ] UI changes preserve keyboard access, visible focus, and reduced motion.
- [ ] Copied/downloaded sources include required files and dependencies, if affected.
